description:
You are an instrument-rated pilot preparing for a night IFR cross-country flight from San Francisco (KSFO) to Denver (KDEN). Before departure you need to configure your Avare EFB for night flying and ensure it is displaying the correct IFR charts for en-route navigation.

Your task: (1) Enable Night Mode in Avare so the display is optimised for dark cockpit conditions, (2) switch the chart type to IFR Low-Altitude Enroute charts (the standard chart for IFR flights below 18,000 ft), and (3) build and save a flight plan that includes KSFO as departure and KDEN as destination. All three sub-tasks must be completed.
